PROBLEM STATEMENT

You are given one week of trip data from a two-wheeler delivery/rider fleet operated by VexarDrive Technologies. The dataset covers 30 drivers, 30 vehicles, and 450 trips (15 trips per driver), with per-minute GPS and IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) sensor readings captured from the driver's mobile phone during each trip.
Using this data, build TWO dashboards:
1. Driver Behaviour Dashboard - identify and score risky vs. safe driving patterns per driver.
2. Vehicle Health Status Dashboard - identify vehicles showing signs of mechanical wear or irregular sensor signatures that may need maintenance.
For each metric or score shown on your dashboards, you must justify why that value is what it is (i.e. show your reasoning/methodology, not just the number) and clearly note any assumptions.
You should also propose what else this dataset could be used for beyond these two dashboards.
DATASET STRUCTURE
• Drivers - one row per driver (master data)
• Vehicles - one row per vehicle (master data)
• Trips - one row per trip, with trip-level summary stats
• Telemetry - one row per minute per trip: GPS + accelerometer + gyroscope readings
HOW THE SHEETS JOIN
Telemetry.Trip_ID  → Trips.Trip_ID
Trips.Driver_ID    → Drivers.Driver_ID
Trips.Vehicle_ID   → Vehicles.Vehicle_ID
